The '''2007–08 Süper Lig''' season, (also known as the [[Turkcell]] [[Süper Lig]] for sponsorship reasons), was the 50th anniversary of top-flight professional [[association football|football]] in Turkey. It was won by [[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]], who won their 17th championship.

Since Turkey had climbed from 15th to 14th position in the UEFA association coefficient rankings at the end of the 2006–07 season, and [[UEFA Champions League]]-bound [[FC Zenit Saint Petersburg|Zenit Saint Petersburg]] won the [[2007–08 UEFA Cup]], the domestic cup winner, [[Kayserispor]], which had qualified for the second qualifying round of the [[2008–09 UEFA Cup]], was promoted to the first round, filling the unused title holder spot.

The league began on 10 August 2007 with the [[İstanbul Başakşehir F.K.|İstanbul B.B.]]–[[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] match at [[Atatürk Olympic Stadium]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.angelfire.com/nj/sivritepe/index.html|title=Turkish-soccer.com|access-date=4 May 2007| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20070513181730/http://www.angelfire.com/nj/sivritepe/index.html| archive-date= 13 May 2007| url-status= live}}</ref>

The three relegated clubs would be replaced by three promoted clubs from the [[Bank Asya 1. Lig]]. Gençlerbirliği OFTAŞ and İstanbul B.B. both earned automatic promotion, while [[Altay S.K.|Altay]], [[Diyarbakırspor]], [[Kasımpaşa S.K.|Kasımpaşa]] and [[Malatyaspor]] played in the play-off tournament with Kasımpaşa coming out victorious, becoming the third and last club to be promoted to the Süper Lig for 2007–08.

==Events==

===Matchday 1===
The league started with a surprise result, with [[İstanbul Başakşehir F.K.|İstanbul B.B.]] defeating giants Fenerbahçe 2–0.<ref>[http://www.samanyoluhaber.com/index.php?khide=1&ghide=1&hid=64508&sec=14 Opinions of football columnists about Fenerbahçe] Retrieved on 12 September 2007</ref> Another important event of the first week was the record of [[Hakan Şükür]]. By scoring two goals, he managed to reach to the record of the most goals scored domestically.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20070919040744/http://www.uefa.com/footballeurope/news/kind=2/newsid=580257.html UEFA news about Hakan Şükür] Retrieved on 12 September 2007</ref> The Trabzonspor–Sivasspor match was suspended due to "player and fan trouble", just minutes before the referee would end it. The Federation ultimately awarded a default 3–0 victory to [[Sivasspor]].<ref>[http://www.tff.org/Default.aspx?pageId=200&ftxtId=2239 Yönetim Kurulu Kararları]</ref> This caused a harsh opposition from the Trabzonspor side.

===Matchday 7===
The first derby of the season was the main event of this week but the decision of [[Karl Heinz Feldkamp]] became the center of the discussion rather than the match between Galatasaray and Beşiktaş because he decided to exclude two important players of his team, Şükür and Lincoln, from the match squad. The reason was their disciplinary problems. This week is also worth mentioning because none of the matches ended with a draw.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Galatasaray v Beşiktaş |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c4njpje1gp2t |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=BBC Sport |language=en-GB}}</ref>

===Matchday 10===
Fenerbahçe, after collecting five points in three [[2007–08 UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] matches, faced the newcomer of the league, Kasımpaşa. Fenerbahçe hardly won the game which they were expected to dominate. On the other field of the competition, Galatasaray secured the victory in the last minutes and the surprise leader of the 9th Week, Sivasspor, was defeated by the desperate Konyaspor. One of the key events of the week was the transfer of [[Ersun Yanal]], former national team manager, to Trabzonspor. [[Ziya Doğan]] left his seat after the shocking defeat at the hands of Beşiktaş in the 9th week where Trabzonspor lost its early advantage of 2–0 and ended up losing the game 2–3.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20080207100520/http://www.todayszaman.com/tz-web/detaylar.do?load=detay&link=125694|title=Can coach Ersun Yanal Deliver at Trabzonspor?}}</ref><ref>[http://www.sabah.com.tr/2007/10/20/haber,5649663A07264ED1A6740B689F3E4B69.html Trabzonspor:2 Beşiktaş:3]</ref>

===Matchday 24===
Beşiktaş hosted Galatasaray on their 319th randez-vous.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.guncel.net/bjk-gs-derbi-tarihinden-ilginc-notlar_01-03-2008 |title=BJK-GS derbi tarihinden ilginç notlar Eng:(Interesting notes of derby matches history |access-date=3 March 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080303161812/http://www.guncel.net/bjk-gs-derbi-tarihinden-ilginc-notlar_01-03-2008 |archive-date=3 March 2008 |url-status=dead |df=dmy-all }}</ref> Both teams had critical absences such as injured [[Deivson Rogério da Silva|Bobo]] and suspended [[Lincoln (footballer, born 1979)|Lincoln]].<ref>[http://www.milliyet.com.tr/default.aspx?aType=HaberDetay&ArticleID=501108&Date=03.03.2008 Lincoln'e Taciz (Eng:Lincoln was teased in half time]</ref> Beşiktaş won the game with final score of 1–0.<ref>[http://www.hurriyet.com.tr/spor/futbol/8355873.asp?gid=229&sz=47937 Derbiden Koltuk Çıktı]</ref> [[Marcio Nobre|Mert Nobre]] have scored to Galatasaray for the 6th time in his career as he already scored 3 whilst his Fenerbahçe spelling.<ref>[http://www.hurriyet.com.tr/spor/futbol/8356873.asp?gid=71&sz=98601 Galatarasay'ın Belalısı Nobre Eng:(Nobre,troubler of Gala]</ref> Nobre could only score once in the first half of the season, then he accelerated his form and earned 6 goals until 24th week. Thereby, Beşiktaş captured the top of table after 137 weeks of the league.<ref>[http://www.hurriyet.com.tr/spor/futbol/8360247.asp?gid=211&sz=91145 Zirvedeli 5 takımın son 10 maçı]</ref><ref>[http://www.cnnturk.com/SPOR/FUTBOL/haber_detay.asp?PID=177&haberID=433779 Galatasaray'ı Yenen Beşiktaş Lider]{{Dead link|date=April 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> Almost entire Beşiktaş squad and board including chairman [[Yıldırım Demirören]] and coach [[Ertuğrul Sağlam]] had achieved the top position of the league for the very first time in their personal careers; squad exceptions were [[Serdar Özkan]], [[Gökhan Zan]], and captain [[İbrahim Üzülmez]].<ref>[http://www.hurriyet.com.tr/sondakika/8361700.asp?gid=71&sz=23683 Beşiktaş'ta ilk kez liderlik yaşayanlar]</ref>

===Matchday 28===
The most important match up of the weekend was between Beşiktaş and Fenerbahçe. ''Sarı Kanaryalar'' had already captured the leadership previous week, Beşiktaş was on target to overtake them again as the home side winner on last 6 weeks.<ref name=Lineups>{{cite news
| title = Derbi Maca Dogru Ilk 11'ler
| url = http://www.milliyet.com.tr/default.aspx?aType=SonDakika&Kategori=spor&ArticleID=510583&Date=28.03.2008
| date = 29 March 2008
| access-date = 3 May 2008| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20080331235424/http://www.milliyet.com.tr/default.aspx?aType=SonDakika&Kategori=spor&ArticleID=510583&Date=28.03.2008| archive-date= 31 March 2008| url-status= live|language=tr}}</ref><ref name="BJK vs FB">{{cite news
| title = Kartal Ağır Yaralı
| url = http://www.milliyet.com.tr/default.aspx?aType=SonDakika&ArticleID=511041&Date=29.03.2008&Kategori=spor&ver=0177
| publisher = hurriyet.com.tr
| date = 29 March 2008
| access-date = 5 May 2008| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20080603000752/http://www.milliyet.com.tr/default.aspx?aType=SonDakika&ArticleID=511041&Date=29.03.2008&Kategori=spor&ver=0177| archive-date= 3 June 2008| url-status= live|language=tr}}</ref>

Fenerbahçe started the match well with the header of [[Alex de Souza|Alex]] after [[Colin Kazım-Richards]]' cross from the right side. Kazım will have been to score against [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]] on next match in [[2007–08 UEFA Champions League|Champions League]]. Beşiktaş equalized the scoresheet with [[Serdar Özkan]]'s goal; however, Alex closed the curtain with his second goal as he became the man of the match.<ref name="Alex against BJK">{{cite news
| title = İnönü Sambacısı
| url = http://hurarsiv.hurriyet.com.tr/goster/haber.aspx?id=8574300&tarih=2008-03-29
| publisher = hurriyet.com.tr
| date = 29 March 2008
| access-date = 2 May 2008|language=tr}}</ref><ref name=result>{{cite news
| title = Maç Sonucu
| url = http://www.milliyet.com.tr/default.aspx?aType=SonDakika&Kategori=spor&ArticleID=510984&Date=29.03.2008
| publisher = milliyet.com.tr
| date = 29 March 2008
| access-date = 5 May 2008| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20080428231152/http://www.milliyet.com.tr/default.aspx?aType=SonDakika&Kategori=spor&ArticleID=510984&Date=29.03.2008| archive-date= 28 April 2008| url-status= live|language=tr}}</ref> This was a big impact on Beşiktaş due to the victory of [[Sivasspor]] as they even lost the second place which they would lose the chance to join [[UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] next season. During the match, Yıldırım Demirören's mother got feel faint, it was diagnosed that she had a sudden hypertension. Demirören had to leave the match in early minutes.<ref>{{cite news
| title = Demiroren'i Korkutan Olay
| url = http://hurarsiv.hurriyet.com.tr/goster/haber.aspx?id=8575526&tarih=2008-03-29
| publisher = hurriyet.com.tr
| date = 29 March 2008
| access-date = 5 May 2008|language=tr}}</ref> Alex was protested by Beşiktaş supporters after manipulated the situations during the corner kicks.<ref name="Alex pretends as injured">{{cite news
| title = Once kivrandi, sonra kullandi.
| url = http://hurarsiv.hurriyet.com.tr/goster/haber.aspx?id=8575377&tarih=2008-03-29
| publisher = hurriyet.com.tr
| date = 29 March 2008
| access-date = 4 May 2008|language=tr}}</ref> The referee had added 4 and 8 minutes of stoppage time, sum of 12.

Galatasaray was fined by TFF and played against Gaziantepspor with no audience. This was the 6th match without the supporters this season due to be disciplined; nevertheless ''Cimbom'' was able to win 5 times that far.<ref>{{cite news
| title = Galatasaray sessizliği seviyor
| url = http://www.milliyet.com.tr/default.aspx?aType=SonDakika&Kategori=spor&ArticleID=510888&Date=29.03.2008
| publisher = milliyet.com.tr
| date = 29 March 2008
| access-date = 5 May 2008| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20080531073250/http://www.milliyet.com.tr/default.aspx?aType=SonDakika&Kategori=spor&ArticleID=510888&Date=29.03.2008| archive-date= 31 May 2008| url-status= live|language=tr}}</ref> They had a 0–0 draw with Gaziantep.

===Matchday 29===
Turkish Professional Discipline Board fined Beşiktaş for two matches, one to play in a neutral stadium and one with no audience due to manifestations consisting oaths on TFF and the referees in the match against Fenerbahçe previous weekend.<ref>{{cite news
| title = Beşiktaş'a Şok Ceza
| url = http://hurarsiv.hurriyet.com.tr/goster/haber.aspx?id=8652662&tarih=2008-04-08
| publisher = hurriyet.com.tr
| date = 8 April 2008
| access-date = 8 May 2008|language=tr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-01-27 |title=Türkiye: Sorumlu Oyun |url=https://mostbet1-turkey.com/responsible-gaming/ |access-date=2024-07-19 |language=tr-TR}}</ref><ref>{{cite news
| title = Beşiktaş'a Seyircisiz Oynama ve Saha Kapatma Cezası
| url = http://www.haberler.com/bjk-ya-seyirciyiz-oynama-ve-saha-kapama-cezasi-haberi/
| publisher = haberler.com
| date = 8 April 2008
| access-date = 8 May 2008| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20080416062035/http://www.haberler.com/bjk-ya-seyirciyiz-oynama-ve-saha-kapama-cezasi-haberi/| archive-date= 16 April 2008| url-status= live|language=tr}}</ref>

The most unexpected news was the resignation of [[Karl-Heinz Feldkamp]] from Galatasaray. Club officials declared that the reason was the opinion gap between Feldkamp and club board.<ref name=Feldkamp>{{cite news
| title = Galatasaray Teknik Direktoru Feldkamp Istifa Etti.
| url = http://hurarsiv.hurriyet.com.tr/goster/haber.aspx?id=8627137&tarih=2008-04-05
| publisher = hurriyet.com.tr
| date = 4 April 2008
| access-date = 12 April 2008|language=tr}}</ref> On the later emerging news on the papers, it was claimed that the very last reason was Feldkamp's tactical changes on the team and selection before the match against [[Gençlerbirliği]] which did not consist [[Hakan Şükür]], [[Hasan Şaş]] and [[Okan Buruk]].<ref name=kalli>{{cite news
| title = İşte Kallinin Son Çılgınlığı
| url = http://www.milliyet.com.tr/default.aspx?aType=SonDakika&Kategori=spor&ArticleID=514192&Date=07.04.2008
| publisher = milliyet.com.tr
| date = 7 April 2008
| access-date = 17 April 2008| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20080411044027/http://www.milliyet.com.tr/default.aspx?aType=SonDakika&Kategori=spor&ArticleID=514192&Date=07.04.2008| archive-date= 11 April 2008| url-status= live|language=tr}}</ref><ref name=mistakes>{{cite news
| title = Kallinin İpini Çeken Şok İddia.
| url = http://www.hurriyet.com.tr/spor/futbol/8640943.asp?gid=229&sz=68621
| publisher = hurriyet.com.tr
| date = 7 April 2008
| access-date = 17 April 2008|language=tr}}</ref>

Sivasspor hosted Beşiktaş as Fenerbahçe did for Kayserispor in the very crucial encounters of the weekend. Galatasaray was the guest of Gençlerbirliği. All three matches finished with narrow scores, therefore Fenerbahçe kept going as the leader. [[Lincoln (footballer, born 1979)|Lincoln]] was the scorer for ''Cimbom''.<ref name="lincoln against GB">{{cite news
| title = Lincoln Çamurdan Çıkardı.
| url = http://hurarsiv.hurriyet.com.tr/goster/haber.aspx?id=8634421&tarih=2008-04-06
| publisher = hurriyet.com.tr
| date = 6 April 2008
| access-date = 5 May 2008|language=tr}}</ref>

İstanbul B.B. manager [[Abdullah Avcı]] was linked with Galatasaray after his successful performance throughout the season.<ref name="Avci to decide">{{cite news
| title = Avcı için karar günü
| url = http://hurarsiv.hurriyet.com.tr/goster/haber.aspx?id=8635795&tarih=2008-04-06
| publisher = hurriyet.com.tr
| date = 6 April 2008
| access-date = 5 May 2008|language=tr}}</ref>

Former Beşiktaş player [[Pascal Nouma]] was in Turkey to follow the Beşiktaş' match as he claimed that his former team to reach the title at the end of the season.<ref name="Nouma in Istanbul">{{cite news
| title = Nouma: Şampiyon Beşiktaş olacak
| url = http://hurarsiv.hurriyet.com.tr/goster/haber.aspx?id=8634375&tarih=2008-04-06
| publisher = hurriyet.com.tr
| date = 6 April 2008
| access-date = 5 May 2008|language=tr}}</ref>

===Matchday 31===
Kasımpaşa were relegated to [[Bank Asya 1. Lig]], after their away match loss against [[Bursaspor]] with a 1–0 score.

===Matchday 32===
At the biggest game of the season, Galatasaray defeated Fenerbahçe 1–0 at the [[Ali Sami Yen Stadium]] and went three points clear at the top of the table. Çaykur Rizespor were relegated to [[Bank Asya 1. Lig]], after their away match loss against [[Kayserispor]] with a 3–0 score.

===Matchday 33===
[[Manisaspor Vestel Manisaspor]] were relegated to [[Bank Asya 1. Lig]] following a home loss against relegated [[Kasımpaşa S.K.|Kasımpaşa]] with a 2–1 score. Galatasaray defeated Sivasspor 5–3 at an away match and took a big step to the title.<ref>{{cite news
| title = Şampiyon Gibi
| url = http://hurarsiv.hurriyet.com.tr/goster/haber.aspx?id=8854597&tarih=2008-05-04
| publisher = hurriyet.com.tr
| date = 4 May 2008
| access-date = 4 May 2008|language=tr}}</ref> Fenerbahçe defeated Gençlerbirliği 3–2 at home and guaranteed [[UEFA Champions League]] qualification.<ref>{{cite news
| title = Takibe Devam
| url = http://hurarsiv.hurriyet.com.tr/goster/haber.aspx?id=8855993&tarih=2008-05-04
| publisher = hurriyet.com.tr
| date = 4 May 2008
| access-date = 8 May 2008|language=tr}}</ref>

===Matchday 34===
Galatasaray won their 17th championship after defeating Gençlerbirliği OFTAŞ 2–0. Fenerbahçe finished in second position after losing 2–0 to Trabzonspor. Beşiktaş finished in third position, securing a [[UEFA Europa League|UEFA Cup]] spot, after winning 5–1 against relegated Vestel Manisaspor. Sivasspor won 2–0 against Gençlerbirliği, but could only qualify for [[UEFA Intertoto Cup]] after finishing in fourth, behind Fenerbahçe and Beşiktaş, because of a poor head-to-head record against those two teams.<ref>{{cite news
| title = Kim şampiyon, kim UEFA'da?
| url = http://www.milliyet.com.tr/default.aspx?aType=SonDakika&Kategori=spor&ArticleID=526173&Date=10.05.2008
| publisher = milliyet.com.tr
| date = 10 May 2008
| access-date = 10 May 2008| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20080513035743/http://www.milliyet.com.tr/default.aspx?aType=SonDakika&Kategori=spor&ArticleID=526173&Date=10.05.2008| archive-date= 13 May 2008| url-status= live|language=tr}}</ref>

==Teams promoted/relegated==
The teams promoted from the [[TFF First League]] for the 2006–07 season:
*[[Gençlerbirliği OFTAŞ]] (1st)
*[[İstanbul Başakşehir F.K.|İstanbul B.B.]] (2nd)

The teams relegated to the [[TFF First League]] for the 2006–07 season:
*[[Sakaryaspor]] (18th)
*[[Kayseri Erciyesspor]] (17th)
*[[Antalyaspor]] (16th)
